title: Tractable Relaxations of Multivariate Stochastic Dominance via Optimal Transport and CVaR
summary: Many operational decisions involve alternatives with several uncertain attributes. When comparing such alternatives, stochastic dominance requires every decision maker in a prescribed class to prefer one alternative to the other. These orders have two known limitations: a single extreme decision maker can rule out dominance, and multivariate dominance can be difficult to verify.
